name: Kalo Xyln
found: Begging on the Nebruz boardwalks by day; locked in his house by dark.
appearance: Legless below the knee. Short crutches. Eyes that expect the worst.
sayings: Do you hear them? On the boards?
wants: Scraps. The footsteps outside to stop.
knows: The renegade lizard-folk band, by sight.
tragedies: He was captured by a renegade band of lizard-folk (exiles from the treaty tribes) who tortured him and ate his legs over several days. Leeandra drove them off and returned him to Nebruz. His body survived; his mind did not.
He believes his severed legs return each night to walk outside his door and collect the rest of him.
dm_notes: The footsteps are real. A renegade scout walks the boards under his door each new moon, watching the one man who can name the band.
